text: Preflight now requires explicit positive evaluation-edge multiplicity, reports per-edge and total dense schedule bytes and factorization units, and makes the lowering decision on total storage. It also records that metric matrices are derived on demand from frozen recipes. With 8 edges, the 55,296-node benchmark now reports 5.28 GiB per edge, 42.26 GiB total, and support_streamed_only.
